blocks.text: 143-darsda **up** — boshlash, ulg'ayish va natija edi. Bu darsda **up** ning eng «grammatik» ma'nosi — harakatning **oxirigacha, to'liq** bajarilishi. Fe'lning ma'nosi deyarli o'zgarmaydi, **up** faqat natijani kuchaytiradi: eat — yemoq, eat **up** — yeb **bitirmoq**; use — ishlatmoq, use **up** — ishlatib **tugatmoq**; tear — yirtmoq, tear **up** — yirtib **tashlamoq**. O'zbekchada bu vazifani aynan ko'makchi fe'llar bajaradi: «-ib bo'lmoq», «-ib bitirmoq», «-ib tashlamoq», «-ib qo'ymoq». Qizil kitobda cheer up, tidy up kabi fe'llar uchragan (→ qizil kitob, 121–122-darslar); bu yerda ularni ma'no guruhlari bo'yicha tizimlaymiz.

blocks.text: Tugatish va tozalash: use up, tidy up, wash up

**use up** — zaxirani oxirigacha ishlatmoq (use up the milk, our data, all our savings). **fill up** — to'ldirmoq (fill up the tank) yoki o'zi to'lmoq (the hall filled up). **dry up** — qurib qolmoq (daryo) yoki «oqim» to'xtamoq (pul, ish). Tozalashda: **tidy up** — narsalarni joy-joyiga qo'ymoq, **clean up** — iflosni tozalamoq, **clear up** — stolni, xonani yig'ishtirmoq. Ehtiyot bo'ling: BrE da **wash up** — **idish yuvmoq**, AmE da esa — qo'l-yuz yuvmoq. **clear up** ning yana uch ma'nosi: ob-havo **ochilmoq**, kasallik **o'tib ketmoq**, tushunmovchilikni **bartaraf qilmoq**.

items.text: We've **used up** this month's budget, and it's only the twentieth.
items.translation: Bu oylik byudjetni **sarflab bo'ldik**, holbuki bugun atigi yigirmanchi sana.

items.text: I'll cook if you **wash up** — that's fair, isn't it?
items.translation: Sen **idish yuvsang**, men ovqat qilaman — adolatli, to'g'rimi?

items.text: The sky **cleared up** in the afternoon, and we went for a walk.
items.translation: Tushdan keyin osmon **ochildi** va biz sayrga chiqdik.

blocks.text: Yopish va bo'laklash: do up, wrap up, break up

**up** yopish yoki mahkamlash natijasini ham bildiradi: **do up** (tugma, zamok qadamoq; uyni ta'mirlamoq), **lock up** (hamma eshiklarni qulflamoq), **tie up** (bog'lamoq; **be tied up** — juda band bo'lmoq), **wrap up** (o'ramoq; issiq kiyinmoq; yig'ilishni yakunlamoq). Aksincha, butun narsani **bo'laklarga ajratish** ham up: **tear up**, **cut up**, **chop up**, **blow up** (portlatmoq; shishirmoq; jahl bilan portlab ketmoq), **break up** (munosabat uzilmoq, olomon tarqalmoq, BrE: maktab ta'tilga chiqmoq), **split up** (ajrashmoq).

items.text: Sarah **broke up with** her boyfriend by text message, which everyone thought was cruel.
items.translation: Sara yigiti bilan SMS orqali **munosabatni uzdi**, buni hamma shafqatsizlik deb hisobladi.

items.text: I'm **tied up** in meetings all morning, but I'm free after lunch.
items.translation: Ertalab bo'yi yig'ilishlar bilan **bandman**, lekin tushlikdan keyin bo'shman.

blocks.text: Kayfiyat va chalkashlik: cheer up, mix up

**cheer up** — o'zi xursand bo'lmoq (**Cheer up!**) yoki kimningdir kayfiyatini ko'tarmoq (cheer sb up); **brighten up** — (xona, kun, chehra) yorishmoq; **liven up** — jonlantirmoq. **mix up** — ikki narsani **chalkashtirmoq**: I always **mix up** their names; sifat shakli — **mixed up**: I got the dates **mixed up**; ot — a **mix-up** (chalkashlik). **open up** — dilini ochmoq. **shut up** — «jim bo'l», juda qo'pol; muloyim variant — Could you be quiet, please?
Pul, vaqt va sur'at: save up, hold up, keep up with

**save up** (for) — biror maqsad uchun asta-sekin **pul yig'moq**. **hold up** — kechiktirmoq, ko'pincha majhul: I was **held up** in traffic; ikkinchi ma'nosi — qurol bilan talamoq (ot: a **hold-up**). **add up** — qo'shib hisoblamoq yoki «mantiqqa to'g'ri kelmoq» (His story doesn't **add up**). **keep up (with)** — ortda qolmaslik, teng yurmoq; **keep up** the good work — shu ruhda davom etmoq. **catch up (with)** — ortda qolgandan keyin **yetib olmoq**; **catch up on** — qoldirgan ish, yangilik yoki uyquning o'rnini to'ldirmoq. Farq: **keep up** — boshidan teng yurish, **catch up** — orqada qolib, keyin yetib olish.

items.text: Jasur is **saving up** for a new laptop, so he isn't eating out at the moment.
items.translation: Jasur yangi noutbuk uchun **pul yig'yapti**, shuning uchun hozir tashqarida ovqatlanmayapti.

items.text: Our flight was **held up** for two hours because of a technical problem.
items.translation: Texnik nosozlik tufayli reysimiz ikki soatga **kechiktirildi**.

items.text: The course moves so fast that some students struggle to **keep up**.
items.translation: Kurs shunchalik tez ketyaptiki, ba'zi talabalar **ortda qolmaslik** uchun qiynalishyapti.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «My English isn't enough to keep with them» → to **keep up with** them; «I confused the dates» — to'g'ri, lekin so'zlashuvda ko'proq I **got** the dates **mixed up**; «We finished the money» → We **used up** / **ran out of** the money; «I'm collecting money for a car» → I'm **saving up** for a car (collect — boshqalardan yig'moq); «I was late because the traffic» → I was **held up** in traffic; «Cheer up him» → **cheer** him **up** (olmosh o'rtada); **wash up** ni AmE ma'nosida (qo'l yuvmoq) tushunish — Britaniyada bu idish yuvish; **Shut up!** ni muloyim «jim bo'ling» deb ishlatish — u qo'pol.

Fe'lga **up** qo'shilganda o'zbekchaga «-ib bo'lmoq / -ib bitirmoq / -ib tashlamoq / -ib qo'ymoq» qo'shib ko'ring: eat up — yeb bitirmoq, use up — ishlatib bo'lmoq, tear up — yirtib tashlamoq, tidy up — yig'ishtirib qo'ymoq. Ma'no tabiiy chiqsa — **up** «butunlay» ma'nosida ishlayapti.

Bog'lanish: up — yuqoriga, ko'proq (turn up, put up) — 142-dars; up — boshlash, natija (set up, end up) — 143-dars; out — butunlay (run out, sell out) — 139-dars; frazali fe'l turlari va olmosh o'rni — 137-dars.

examples.title: Finishing completely: **use up**, **eat up**, **fill up**
examples.description: **up** — butunlay, oxirigacha: **use up** — ishlatib tugatmoq; **eat up** / **drink up** — yeb / ichib bitirmoq; **fill up** — to'ldirmoq, to'lmoq; **dry up** — qurib qolmoq, to'xtab qolmoq; **top up** — (telefonga) pul tashlamoq, to'ldirib qo'ymoq.

sentences.text: Someone has **used up** all the milk and put the empty bottle back in the fridge!
sentences.translation: Kimdir butun sutni **ishlatib tugatibdi** va bo'sh shishani muzlatgichga qaytarib qo'yibdi!

sentences.text: Try to **use up** the vegetables before they go bad.
sentences.translation: Sabzavotlar aynib qolmasidan oldin ularni **ishlatib bo'lishga** harakat qil.

sentences.text: **Eat up** your soup, or there's no ice cream later!
sentences.translation: Sho'rvangni **ichib bitir**, bo'lmasa keyin muzqaymoq yo'q!

sentences.text: Let's **fill up** the car before we leave Tashkent — petrol costs more on the motorway.
sentences.translation: Toshkentdan chiqishdan oldin mashinaga **to'liq benzin quyaylik** — magistralda benzin qimmatroq.

sentences.text: The lecture hall **filled up** quickly, so we had to stand at the back.
sentences.translation: Ma'ruza zali tez **to'lib qoldi**, shuning uchun orqada tik turishga majbur bo'ldik.

sentences.text: Because of the drought, many small rivers in the region have **dried up**.
sentences.translation: Qurg'oqchilik tufayli viloyatdagi ko'plab kichik daryolar **qurib qoldi**.

sentences.text: The money from the government **dried up** after two years, and the project closed.
sentences.translation: Hukumatdan keladigan mablag' ikki yildan keyin **to'xtab qoldi**, loyiha yopildi.

sentences.text: We've **used up** our data allowance, so the internet is really slow now.
sentences.translation: Internet paketimizni **ishlatib bo'ldik**, shuning uchun hozir internet juda sekin.

sentences.text: I need to **top up** my phone before I call Grandma in Fergana.
sentences.translation: Farg'onadagi buvimga qo'ng'iroq qilishdan oldin telefonimga **pul tashlashim** kerak.

sentences.text: If you keep spending like this, you'll **use up** all your savings by December.
sentences.translation: Shu tarzda pul sarflayversang, dekabrgacha barcha jamg'armangni **sarflab tugatasan**.

examples.title: Cleaning: **tidy up**, **wash up**, **clear up**
examples.description: **tidy up** — yig'ishtirmoq, tartibga keltirmoq; **clean up** — iflosni tozalamoq; **wash up** (BrE) — idish yuvmoq; **clear up** — yig'ishtirmoq; (ob-havo) ochilmoq; (kasallik) o'tib ketmoq; (tushunmovchilikni) bartaraf qilmoq.

sentences.text: **Tidy up** your room before your grandparents arrive — it's a mess!
sentences.translation: Bobo-buving kelishidan oldin xonangni **yig'ishtir** — ostin-ustin bo'lib yotibdi!

sentences.text: After the festival, volunteers spent two days **cleaning up** the park.
sentences.translation: Festivaldan keyin ko'ngillilar bog'ni **tozalashga** ikki kun sarflashdi.

sentences.text: Who's going to **clean up** this mess? It wasn't me!
sentences.translation: Bu tartibsizlikni kim **tozalaydi**? Men qilmadim!

sentences.text: In our family, whoever cooks doesn't have to **wash up**.
sentences.translation: Oilamizda ovqat qilgan odam **idish yuvmaydi**.

sentences.text: Dad **washed up** while Mum put the children to bed.
sentences.translation: Onam bolalarni yotqizayotganda dadam **idish-tovoqni yuvdi**.

sentences.text: It's raining now, but the forecast says it will **clear up** by the afternoon.
sentences.translation: Hozir yomg'ir yog'yapti, lekin ob-havo ma'lumotiga ko'ra tushdan keyin **ochilib ketadi**.

sentences.text: My skin rash **cleared up** after a week of using the cream.
sentences.translation: Kremni bir hafta surtganimdan keyin terimdagi toshma **o'tib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Let's **clear up** this misunderstanding before it becomes a real problem.
sentences.translation: Bu tushunmovchilik haqiqiy muammoga aylanmasidan oldin uni **bartaraf qilaylik**.

sentences.text: When the guests had gone, we **cleared up** the plates and glasses.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar ketgach, likopcha va qadahlarni **yig'ishtirdik**.

sentences.text: Could someone help me **tidy up** these files? I can't find anything.
sentences.translation: Kimdir bu fayllarni **tartibga solishga** yordam bera oladimi? Hech narsani topa olmayapman.

examples.title: Fastening and finishing: **do up**, **lock up**, **wrap up**
examples.description: **do up** — (tugma, zamok, taqinchoq) qadamoq; (uyni) ta'mirlamoq; **lock up** — hamma eshiklarni qulflamoq; **tie up** — bog'lab qo'ymoq; **be tied up** — band bo'lmoq; **wrap up** — o'ramoq; issiq kiyinmoq; yakunlamoq; **zip up** — zamokni tortmoq.

sentences.text: Can you help me **do up** this necklace? The clasp is tiny.
sentences.translation: Shu marjonni **taqib qo'yishga** yordam berasanmi? Ilmog'i juda mayda.

sentences.text: Bekzod and Madina bought an old house and spent a year **doing** it **up**.
sentences.translation: Bekzod va Madina eski uy sotib olib, uni **ta'mirlashga** bir yil sarflashdi.

sentences.text: The last person to leave the office has to **lock up** and set the alarm.
sentences.translation: Ofisdan oxirgi chiqqan odam hamma eshiklarni **qulflashi** va signalizatsiyani yoqishi kerak.

sentences.text: **Wrap up** warm — it's minus ten in Tashkent today!
sentences.translation: **Issiq kiyining** — bugun Toshkentda minus o'n daraja!

sentences.text: Kate spent the evening **wrapping up** presents for her nephews.
sentences.translation: Keyt oqshomni jiyanlariga sovg'alarni **o'rash** bilan o'tkazdi.

sentences.text: Let's **wrap up** the meeting — we've covered everything on the agenda.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishni **yakunlaylik** — kun tartibidagi hamma narsani ko'rib chiqdik.

sentences.text: The farmer **tied up** his horse outside the shop and went in.
sentences.translation: Dehqon otini do'kon oldida **bog'lab qo'yib**, ichkariga kirdi.

sentences.text: Make sure you **lock** your bike **up** — thefts are common near the station.
sentences.translation: Velosipedingni albatta **qulflab qo'y** — vokzal yaqinida o'g'irlik ko'p bo'ladi.

sentences.text: **Zip up** your bag in the metro — there are pickpockets everywhere.
sentences.translation: Metroda sumkangning zamogini **tortib qo'y** — hamma yoqda cho'ntakkesarlar bor.

sentences.text: I'm sorry I can't talk now — I'm a bit **tied up** with work until Friday.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, hozir gaplasha olmayman — jumagacha ish bilan biroz **bandman**.

examples.title: Into pieces: **break up**, **tear up**, **blow up**
examples.description: **break up** / **split up** — ajrashmoq; (yig'ilish, olomon) tarqalmoq; (BrE: maktab) ta'tilga chiqmoq; **break up** a fight — mushtlashuvni to'xtatmoq; **tear up** / **cut up** / **chop up** — yirtmoq / kesmoq / to'g'ramoq; **blow up** — portlatmoq; shishirmoq; jahli chiqmoq.

sentences.text: Oliver and his girlfriend **split up** last month because she moved to Canada.
sentences.translation: Oliver va qiz do'sti o'tgan oy **ajrashishdi**, chunki qiz Kanadaga ko'chib ketdi.

sentences.text: The police **broke up** the fight before anyone got seriously hurt.
sentences.translation: Hech kim jiddiy jarohat olmasidan oldin politsiya mushtlashuvni **to'xtatdi**.

sentences.text: When do the schools **break up** for the summer holidays this year?
sentences.translation: Bu yil maktablar yozgi ta'tilga qachon **chiqadi**?

sentences.text: He was so angry that he **tore up** the contract in front of everyone.
sentences.translation: Uning jahli shunchalik chiqdiki, hammaning oldida shartnomani **yirtib tashladi**.

sentences.text: **Chop up** the onions and carrots for the plov while I wash the rice.
sentences.translation: Men guruchni yuvayotganimda palov uchun piyoz va sabzini **to'g'rab qo'y**.

sentences.text: **Cut** the meat **up** into small pieces so the children can eat it.
sentences.translation: Bolalar yeya olishi uchun go'shtni mayda bo'laklarga **kesib qo'y**.

sentences.text: The old bridge was **blown up** during the war and never rebuilt.
sentences.translation: Eski ko'prik urush paytida **portlatib yuborilgan** va qayta qurilmagan.

sentences.text: Could you help me **blow up** these balloons for Aziz's party?
sentences.translation: Azizning bazmi uchun shu sharlarni **puflab shishirishga** yordam berasanmi?

sentences.text: The meeting **broke up** at midnight without any agreement.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish hech qanday kelishuvsiz yarim tunda **tarqaldi**.

sentences.text: My boss **blew up** when he saw the mistake in the report.
sentences.translation: Boshlig'im hisobotdagi xatoni ko'rib, jahli chiqib **portlab ketdi**.

examples.title: Feelings: **cheer up**, **mix up**, **open up**
examples.description: **cheer up** — kayfiyati ko'tarilmoq / kayfiyatini ko'tarmoq; **brighten up** — yorishtirmoq; **liven up** — jonlantirmoq; **mix up** — chalkashtirmoq (get sth mixed up); **open up** — dilini ochmoq; **shut up** — jim bo'lmoq (qo'pol).

sentences.text: Jasur was really down after the exam, so we took him out to **cheer** him **up**.
sentences.translation: Jasur imtihondan keyin juda tushkun edi, shuning uchun **kayfiyatini ko'tarish** uchun uni sayrga olib chiqdik.

sentences.text: Come on, **cheer up** — one bad interview doesn't mean you'll never find a job.
sentences.translation: Qani, **boshingni ko'tar** — bitta yomon suhbat hech qachon ish topa olmaysan degani emas.

sentences.text: Some fresh flowers will **brighten up** the room.
sentences.translation: Bir dasta yangi gul xonani **yorishtirib yuboradi**.

sentences.text: I always **mix up** the twins — they look exactly the same!
sentences.translation: Egizaklarni doim **adashtiraman** — ular xuddi bir xil!

sentences.text: Sorry, I **got** the dates **mixed up** — I thought the meeting was tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, sanalarni **chalkashtirib yuboribman** — yig'ilish ertaga deb o'ylabman.

sentences.text: It took months before Bekzod **opened up** about his problems at home.
sentences.translation: Bekzod uydagi muammolari haqida **dilini ochishi** uchun oylar kerak bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Music and a few games really **livened up** the party.
sentences.translation: Musiqa va bir nechta o'yin bazmni rosa **jonlantirib yubordi**.

sentences.text: It's easy to **mix up** these two words because they look so similar.
sentences.translation: Bu ikki so'zni **chalkashtirish** oson, chunki ular juda o'xshash.

sentences.text: The kids were so noisy that the coach shouted at them to **shut up**.
sentences.translation: Bolalar shunchalik shovqin qilishdiki, murabbiy ularga **jim bo'linglar** deb baqirdi.

sentences.text: A long walk by the river always **cheers** me **up** when I'm stressed.
sentences.translation: Asabim buzilganda daryo bo'yida uzoq sayr qilish doim **kayfiyatimni ko'taradi**.

examples.title: Money and delays: **save up**, **hold up**, **add up**
examples.description: **save up** (for) — pul yig'moq; **hold up** — kechiktirmoq (be held up); qurollanib talamoq; **add up** — qo'shib hisoblamoq; mantiqqa to'g'ri kelmoq; **sum up** — xulosa qilmoq; **back up** — (fayllarning) zaxira nusxasini olmoq; qo'llab-quvvatlamoq.

sentences.text: Madina is **saving up** for a trip to Japan next spring.
sentences.translation: Madina kelasi bahorda Yaponiyaga sayohat uchun **pul yig'yapti**.

sentences.text: It took Oliver two years to **save up** enough money for a deposit on a flat.
sentences.translation: Kvartira uchun dastlabki to'lovga yetarli pul **yig'ish** Oliverga ikki yil vaqt oldi.

sentences.text: Sorry I'm late — I was **held up** in traffic for forty minutes.
sentences.translation: Kechikkanim uchun uzr — qirq daqiqa tirbandlikda **qolib ketdim**.

sentences.text: Two men **held up** a petrol station on the outskirts of Manchester last night.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun Manchester chekkasidagi yoqilg'i quyish shoxobchasini ikki kishi **qurol bilan taladi**.

sentences.text: What's **holding up** the project? — We're still waiting for the permits.
sentences.translation: Loyihani nima **ushlab turibdi**? — Hali ham ruxsatnomalarni kutyapmiz.

sentences.text: Can you **add up** these receipts and tell me how much we spent?
sentences.translation: Shu cheklarni **qo'shib chiqib**, qancha sarflaganimizni ayta olasanmi?

sentences.text: His story doesn't **add up** — he said he was at home, but his car was seen in town.
sentences.translation: Uning gapi **mantiqqa to'g'ri kelmaydi** — uyda edim dedi, lekin mashinasini shaharda ko'rishgan.

sentences.text: To **sum up**, the project was a success, but it cost too much.
sentences.translation: **Xulosa qilib aytganda**, loyiha muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldi, lekin juda qimmatga tushdi.

sentences.text: Always **back up** your files — you never know when your laptop might die.
sentences.translation: Fayllaringizning doim **zaxira nusxasini oling** — noutbukingiz qachon ishdan chiqishini hech qachon bilmaysiz.

sentences.text: If the manager asks, will you **back** me **up**?
sentences.translation: Agar menejer so'rasa, meni **qo'llab-quvvatlaysanmi**?

examples.title: Keeping pace: **keep up with**, **catch up**
examples.description: **keep up (with)** — ortda qolmaslik, teng yurmoq; (yangiliklardan) xabardor bo'lib turmoq; **keep up** the good work — shu ruhda davom etmoq; **catch up (with)** — quvib yetmoq, yetib olmoq; **catch up on** — o'rnini to'ldirmoq; **catch up** — (do'st bilan) gaplashib olmoq.

sentences.text: The other runners were so fast that Bekzod couldn't **keep up with** them.
sentences.translation: Boshqa yuguruvchilar shunchalik tez ediki, Bekzod ularga **yetib yura olmadi**.

sentences.text: Prices are rising so fast that salaries can't **keep up**.
sentences.translation: Narxlar shunchalik tez oshyaptiki, maoshlar ularga **yetisha olmayapti**.

sentences.text: How do you **keep up with** the news? — I listen to podcasts on the way to work.
sentences.translation: Yangiliklardan qanday **xabardor bo'lib turasiz**? — Ishga ketayotib podkast tinglayman.

sentences.text: Your English is excellent — **keep up** the good work!
sentences.translation: Ingliz tilingiz a'lo — shu ruhda **davom eting**!

sentences.text: Nilufar missed a month of lectures, and now she's working hard to **catch up**.
sentences.translation: Nilufar bir oylik ma'ruzalarni qoldirdi, endi **yetib olish** uchun astoydil ishlayapti.

sentences.text: The police **caught up with** the thief at the end of the street.
sentences.translation: Politsiya o'g'rini ko'chaning oxirida **quvib yetdi**.

sentences.text: Let's meet for coffee and **catch up** — I haven't seen you for ages!
sentences.translation: Keling, qahvaxonada uchrashib, **gaplashib olaylik** — sizni ko'rmaganimga ancha bo'ldi!

sentences.text: On the plane I finally **caught up on** all the films I'd missed.
sentences.translation: Samolyotda nihoyat o'tkazib yuborgan barcha filmlarimni **ko'rib oldim**.

sentences.text: Small companies struggle to **keep up with** big online shops.
sentences.translation: Kichik kompaniyalar yirik onlayn do'konlar bilan **teng yurishga** qiynaladi.

sentences.text: Even though she started the course late, Kate soon **caught up with** the rest of the group.
sentences.translation: Kursni kech boshlagan bo'lsa ham, Keyt tez orada guruhning qolgan qismiga **yetib oldi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: the morning after the party
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: bazmdan keyingi tong — clean up, wash up, tidy up, use up, cheer up, break up, mix up, hold up, keep up, save up.

sentences.text: — What a mess! Who's going to **clean up** all this?
sentences.translation: — Qanday tartibsizlik! Bularning hammasini kim **tozalaydi**?

sentences.text: — Don't look at me — I **washed up** after the last party!
sentences.translation: — Menga qarama — o'tgan bazmdan keyin men **idish yuvganman**!

sentences.text: — Fine, I'll **tidy up** the living room if you do the kitchen.
sentences.translation: — Mayli, sen oshxonani qilsang, men mehmonxonani **yig'ishtiraman**.

sentences.text: — Deal. Oh no, somebody's **used up** all the coffee.
sentences.translation: — Kelishdik. Voy, kimdir butun qahvani **ishlatib tugatibdi**.

sentences.text: — Sorry, my fault. **Cheer up** — I'll get some more from the shop.
sentences.translation: — Kechirasan, mening aybim. **Xafa bo'lma** — do'kondan yana olib kelaman.

sentences.text: — Thanks. By the way, did Kate and Tom really **break up** last night?
sentences.translation: — Rahmat. Aytgancha, Keyt va Tom kecha rostdan **ajrashishdimi**?

sentences.text: — No, you've **got** it **mixed up** — it was Emma and her boyfriend.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, sen **adashtirib yuboribsan** — bu Emma va uning yigiti edi.

sentences.text: — Let's hurry: if we're **held up**, my parents will arrive before we finish.
sentences.translation: — Shoshilaylik: agar **kechiksak**, ishimizni tugatmasdan ota-onam kelib qoladi.

sentences.text: — Relax. If we **keep up** this speed, we'll be done by eleven.
sentences.translation: — Xotirjam bo'l. Shu sur'atni **saqlab tursak**, o'n birda tugatamiz.

sentences.text: — OK. And next time, let's **save up** for a cleaner instead of a bigger party!
sentences.translation: — Xo'p. Keyingi safar kattaroq bazm o'rniga farrosh uchun **pul yig'aylik**!
